events.body:
## Context

`src/handlers/health.py:25` returns `"documentation": "/docs"`, but there is no `/docs` route; the README says docs are at `/dashboard`. The `endpoints` map (L26-37) also leaves out `/jobs`, `/hackathons` and `/routes`, which `src/main.py` registers.

## What to do

1. Point `documentation` at `/dashboard`.
2. Add the missing endpoints, or build the map from the router the way `make_routes_handler` does.
3. Add `tests/test_health.py` asserting every listed path is a registered route.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every path in the `/health` response resolves
- [ ] New test passes
- [ ] `/v2/health` otherwise unchanged

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-api
cd blt-api && npx wrangler dev   # curl localhost:8787/health
```
